channel.description: Daily tech opinions digest for Yun Zhou

item.title: Andrew Ng: AI Job Anxieties Meet AI Job Opportunities
item.description: LinkedIn data shows AI has helped create 2 million jobs, and AI Engineer is among the top 10 fastest-growing jobs in seven major economies — Ng argues the jobpocalypse story doesn't hold up.

item.title: Cory Doctorow: Against Tech Oligarchy
item.description: A sharp essay-review of a new book on tech-worker union drives: the old quiet organizing playbook fails in tech, where bosses wage labor war — and strikes matter as momentum-builders, not shutdowns.
